poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE SKY REMAINS THE SAME NO MATTER WHERE YOU ARE
poetryFrame.rightVertical: A CONTINUOUS STREAM OF MEMORIES ACROSS TIME'S EDGE
poetryFrame.bottomLine: WE BRIDGE THE MILES WITH THOUGHT AND LIGHT
sonnetLines: Across the miles, a whispered breath,
Where time forgets its steady pace.
We live within this gentle death,
Of moments held in sacred space.
The sun ascends on golden wings,
To chase the shadows of the night.
A guiding glow, a hopeful light.
Through coffee steam and screen's soft gleam,
Our hearts connect beyond the sight.
We ride upon a waking dream,
Across the years, our spirits roam,

lyrics.text: Wondering if thousands of miles away
The sky's just as blue
It's as if I'm stuck in yesterday
When I'm thinking of you
'Cause when you have your morning coffee
I'm turning out the lights so I could dream
And when you smile through the screen
I wish you could be with me
So I lay my head to rest
When the sun is rising
I'll start a brand-new day
When the moon is shining
I long to be with you
In all the places you have been
So today I'm time travelling
